name: Karl Denzlein
sources: Find a Grave, memorial 65818125 (Margaret Denzlein Schriefer, Most Holy Redeemer Cemetery, Baltimore)
Ancestry.com, public member tree "Frank and Shugars Families" (tree 113007221), citing the Mistendorf parish registers and Baltimore church and civil records
notes: UNPROVEN: from the Find a Grave biographies and the "Frank and Shugars Families" member tree, which cites the Mistendorf parish registers; not yet checked against the registers. Born 1 Dec 1822 at house no. 5, Hochstall, and baptized the next day at the Church of the Assumption (Mariä Himmelfahrt), Mistendorf; a farmer at house no. 48, Mistendorf. Married Margaretha Popp there on 8 Feb 1847; their children included Margaretha (1849), Georg (1850–1851), Georg (1853), Margaretha (1860), Barbara (1862) and Margaret (1865). Alive when his wife died in 1877.
UNPROVEN lead: the same tree names his parents as Johann Georg Denzlein (1796–1872) and Barbara Pfeufer (born 1794).
